Rashi on Yevamot 40b:11:1.hebrew: ת"ש מבן בנו מאי לאו משום חולץ דהוי ליה אשת אבי אביו - והיא מן השניות:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:11:1.english: Come [and] hear from “his son's son,” what, is it not because of the one who performs ḥalitza, that she is to him the wife of his father's father - And she is one of the secondary [forbidden relationships].

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:12:1.hebrew: לא משום מיתנא - שהיתה זו אשתו גמורה, ואסורה על בן בנו של חולץ, דהויא לה אשת אחי אבי אביו, וקס"ד דהא נמי משניות היא:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:12:1.english: No, due to the deceased - For this [woman] was his full-fledged wife, and she is forbidden to the son's son of the one who performed chalitzah, since she is [to him] the wife of his father's father's brother; and [the Gemara] presently assumes that this [relationship] too is [one of] the secondary [forbidden relations].

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:13:1.english: But Ameimar rules permissible, etc. - In the chapter [entitled] Keitzad (above, Yevamot 21b).

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:14:1.hebrew: אמימר מוקי לה - להאי בן בנו דמתני' אסבא, אביהן של מת וחולץ דתנא ברישא, דקתני "היא אסורה באביו", והדר תני "ובבנו" של אביו, שהוא אחי המת והחולץ וקמה עליה בלא יבנה משחלץ לה האחד, ולבן בנו של אביהם, דהויא ליה אשת אחי אביו:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:14:1.english: Ameimar establishes it - [He establishes] this "his son's son" of the Mishnah as referring to [that of] the grandfather — [i.e.,] the father of the deceased and of the one who performs ḥalitza, whom [the Mishnah] taught earlier, where it teaches: "She is forbidden to his father" — and then it teaches: "and to his son," [meaning the son] of his father, who is the brother of the deceased and of the one who performs ḥalitza, and she stands under [the prohibition of] "he shall not rebuild" [his brother's house] once the one [brother] has performed ḥalitza with her — and to the son of the son of their father, to whom she is the wife of his father's brother.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:15:1.hebrew: וקתני אחין מן האם - שהיה זה אחיו מן האם או בן אחיו מן האם. ולאו משום חולץ, דא"כ הויא לה שניות בחלוצה, דהא ליתא; אלא אשת אחי האב מן האם, והא בשניות תנינן לה. אלא משום מיתנא, דהוי שניה משום ערוה דאורייתא, דאשתו מעלייתא הוה, וכגון שהיו היבם והחולץ אחין מן האב ומן האם, ולשניהם אח מן האם שלא מן האב:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:15:1.english: And it teaches maternal brothers - [Meaning] that this one was his maternal brother or his maternal brother's son. And [she is forbidden] not because of [her relationship to] the one who performed chalitzah, for if so, it would be [a case of] secondary forbidden relationships with a chalutzah, which does not exist; rather, [she would only be] the wife of the father's maternal brother, and that we learned among the secondary forbidden relationships. Rather, [she is forbidden] because of the deceased [husband], for it is a secondary relationship stemming from a Torah-level forbidden relationship, since she was his full wife; and [this applies] in a case where the yavam [i.e., the deceased] and the one who performed chalitzah were paternal and maternal brothers, and they both had a maternal brother who was not [their] paternal [brother].

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:1.english: That Rabbi Chiya taught - [Referring to] a chalutzah.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:10.english: And his daughter's son - For she is to him the wife of his mother's father. And all of these are secondary forbidden relationships.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:2.english: Four by Torah law - That is to say, with respect to his wife, they are [forbidden] by Torah law.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:3.hebrew: אב - של חולץ, אסור בה מן התורה מפני המת, דהויא ליה כלתו של אב:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:3.english: Father - [The father] of the one who performs ḥalitza is forbidden to her by Torah law on account of the deceased, for she is the father’s daughter-in-law.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:4.hebrew: ובנו - של חולץ, שהיה המת אחי אביו, וערוה היא לגביה:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:4.english: And his son - [The son] of the ḥoletz, since the deceased was his father’s brother, and she is a forbidden relative [ervah] to him.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:5.hebrew: ואחיו - של חולץ, דהוה נמי אחי המת, וקם ליה בלא יבנה:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:5.english: And his brother - [The brother] of the ḥoletz, who was also the brother of the deceased, and he is subject to [the prohibition of] "he shall not build."

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:6.hebrew: ובן אחיו - של חולץ, שהיה המת אחי אביו:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:6.english: And his brother's son - [That is, the brother's son] of the choletz, for the deceased was his father's brother.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:7.english: His father’s father - Because [she is] his son’s daughter-in-law.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:8.english: And his mother's father - Because [she is] his daughter's daughter-in-law.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:9.hebrew: ובן בנו - קס"ד משום חולץ, דהויא ליה אשת אבי אביו:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:16:9.english: And his son's son - It was initially assumed [that this is] on account of the ḥoletz, for she is to him the wife of his father's father.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:19:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן ת"ש ובאבי אמו מאי לאו משום חולץ דהויא ליה כלת בתו לא משום מיתנא דהויא ליה כלת בתו - וכגון שהיו אחין אף מן האם:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:19:1.english: This is how we read [the text]: Come [and] hear: "And to his mother's father." What, is it not because of the one who performs chalitzah, as she is his daughter's daughter-in-law? No, [it is] because of the deceased [brother], as she is his daughter's daughter-in-law - And [this is in a case] such as when they were brothers from the mother as well.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:1:1.hebrew: הוא אסור כו' - כל הנך עריות דאורייתא נינהו באשתו, וגזרינהו רבנן בחלוצתו:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:1:1.english: He is forbidden, etc. - All of these are biblically [prohibited] forbidden relations with respect to his wife, and the Rabbis decreed [them to be prohibited] with respect to his chalutzah.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:1:2.english: While she is alive - [This] refers to her sister, and not to the other forbidden relatives.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:23:1.hebrew: אמימר מוקי לה - ודאי כדקאמרת, משום חולץ, וקסבר גזרו שניות בחלוצה. אבל מאן דאסר באשת אחי אבי האב, מצי לאוקמי משום מיתנא, ותיבעי לך אי גזרו שניות בחלוצה או לא:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:23:1.english: Ameimar establishes it - Indeed, as you say, [he establishes it as being] due to the one who performed chalitzah, and he holds [that the Sages] decreed [that] secondary [forbidden] relationships [apply] to a chalutzah. However, one who forbids the wife of the brother of the father's father can establish [it as being] due to the deceased [husband], and [thus] the question remains for you whether [the Sages] decreed [that] secondary relationships [apply] to a chalutzah or not.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:27:1.hebrew: באיסורה קיימא - חלוצה היא דקיימא ב"לא יבנה" ותו לא, אבל צרתה קיימא עליה באיסור אשת אח בכרת, והולד ממזר:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:27:1.english: She remains in her prohibition - It is the ḥalutza [herself] who stands under [the prohibition of] "he shall not build [his brother's house]" and nothing more, whereas her rival wife remains [forbidden] to him under the prohibition of a brother's wife, [punishable] by karet, and the offspring is a mamzer.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:28:1.hebrew: אי אמרת בשלמא צרה אבראי קיימא - באיסורא קמא, ולא אמרינן חלוצה שליחותא דידה עבדא:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:28:1.english: Granted, if you say that a rival wife stands outside - [she remains] in [her] original prohibition, and we do not say [that] the ḥalutza acted as her agent.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:28:2.hebrew: משום הכי שרי באחותה - דלאו אחות חלוצה היא, ולגבי דידה נמי, כיון דחלוצה לאו שליחות דידה עבדא, לא משויא ליה בלא יבנה, אלא באיסורא קמא קיימא:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:28:2.english: Due to that, he is permitted [to marry] her sister - For she is not the sister of [his] ḥalutza. And regarding [the rival wife] herself as well, since the ḥalutza did not act as her agent, she does not subject him to [the prohibition of] "he shall not build," rather she remains under [her] original prohibition.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:29:1.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת צרה כחלוצה דמיא - דחלוצה שליחותא דידה עבדא ומשוי לה בלא יבנה, א"כ הויא לה צרה כחלוצה, ואמאי שרי באחותה:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:29:1.english: But if you say a rival wife is like a ḥalutzah - [Meaning] that the ḥalutzah acts as her agent and renders her [subject] to [the prohibition of] "he shall not build" — if so, the rival wife is like a ḥalutzah, so why is he permitted to her sister?

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:2:1.english: With his father - On account of [the prohibition of] his daughter-in-law.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:2:2.hebrew: ובאבי אביו - משום כלת בנו. אע"ג דבאשתו גמורה אין אסורה לאבי אביו אלא מדברי סופרים, דהא כלת בנו משניות דרבנן היא, ואפילו הכי גזרוה רבנן נמי בחלוצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:2:2.english: And with his father's father - because of [the prohibition of] his son's daughter-in-law. Even though with his full-fledged wife she is forbidden to his father's father only by rabbinic decree — for his son's daughter-in-law is [one] of the secondary forbidden relationships (sheniyot) by rabbinic law — nevertheless, the Rabbis decreed it regarding a chalutzah as well.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:2:3.english: With his son - Because of [the prohibition of] a father's wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:2:4.english: With his son’s son - Because of [the prohibition of] the wife of his father’s father, who is one of the secondary [forbidden relatives].

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:2:5.english: With his brother - Because of [the prohibition of] a brother's wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:2:6.english: With his brother's son - Because of [the prohibition of] his father's brother's wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:30:1.hebrew: דר' יוחנן - בפרק קמא (לעיל יבמות י:):
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:30:1.english: Of Rabbi Yoḥanan - In the first chapter (above, Yevamot 10b).

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:30:2.english: Nor [are they liable to] karet on account of her rival wife - [This refers to] one who performs ḥalitza for his yevamah, and then he or one of the brothers has relations with her rival wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:31:1.hebrew: ותסברא - דהא ראיה דרב יוסף דאייתי ממתניתין ראיה היא? וכי חלוצה גופא דאורייתא (דרבנן היא), דכי אמרינן צרה כחלוצה, יאסר באחות הצרה:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:31:1.english: And do you think [so] - that this proof of Rav Yosef, which he brought from the Mishnah, is a [valid] proof? Is a chalutzah herself [forbidden] by Torah law? (It is rabbinic.) [So] that when we say a rival wife is like a chalutzah, he would be forbidden to the sister of the rival wife?

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:31:2.hebrew: והאמר ר"ל - לקמן אמתניתין דלקמן:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:31:2.english: And didn’t Reish Lakish say - [He said this] later, on the following Mishnah:

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:31:3.hebrew: כאן שנה רבי - במשנה זו למדנו רבי "אחות גרושה מדברי תורה" וכו', ולקמן מפרש לה. וכיון דאחות חלוצה גופה דרבנן, בחלוצה גזור באחותה, בצרה לא גזור:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:31:3.english: Here Rabbi taught - In this Mishnah, Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] taught us: "a sister of [one's] divorcée [is forbidden] by Torah law," etc., and later [the Gemara] explains it. And since [the prohibition of] a sister of a ḥalutza itself is rabbinic, regarding a ḥalutza they decreed [a prohibition] on her sister, [whereas] regarding a rival wife they did not decree [it].

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:32:1.hebrew: מאי שנא - רישא, קרובת צרת חלוצה, דשריא; ומאי שנא סיפא, צרת קרובת חלוצתו — ששתיהן נכריות, היא וצרתה נשואות לנכרי — וקתני אסור:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:32:1.english: What is different - [regarding] the first clause, the relative of the rival wife of a halutzah, that she is permitted, and what is different [regarding] the latter clause, the rival wife of the relative of his halutzah — for both of them are unrelated [to him], she and her rival wife being married to an unrelated man — yet [the Mishnah] teaches [that she is] forbidden.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:3:1.english: A man is permitted [to marry] a relative of a rival wife of his chalutzah - And we do not say [that] a rival wife is like a chalutzah, and [that] he is [therefore] forbidden to her relatives.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:3:2.hebrew: ואסור בצרת קרובת חלוצתו - ראובן חלץ ללאה, ורחל נשואה לנכרי, ולה צרה, ומת הנכרי — אסורה הצרה לראובן. וטעמא מפרש בגמרא:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:3:2.english: And he is forbidden [to marry] a rival wife of a relative of his ḥalutza - Reuven performed ḥalitza with Leah, and Rachel [her relative] is married to an unrelated man and she has a rival wife, and the unrelated man died — the rival wife is forbidden to Reuven. And the reason is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:4:1.hebrew: גזרו שניות בחלוצה או לא - כגון אם אם אמה ואם אם אביה, דגבי אשתו מיתסרו עליה משום שניות, כדתני רבי חייא בפרק כיצד (לעיל יבמות דף כב.): רביעי שבחמיו ושבחמותו שניה. הכא מאי:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:4:1.english: Did they decree secondary [forbidden] relationships in [the case of] a ḥalutza, or not - For example, her mother's mother's mother and her father's mother's mother, which with respect to his wife are forbidden to him on account of secondary [forbidden] relationships, as Rabbi Chiya taught in chapter Keitzad (above, Yevamot 22a): "The fourth [generation] of his father-in-law and of his mother-in-law is a secondary [forbidden] relationship." Here, what [is the law]?

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:5:1.hebrew: בערוה דאורייתא - כלומר, באשתו, דאמה ואם אמה הוה ערוה דאורייתא, גזרו רבנן שניות; אבל בחלוצה, דאפילו עריות דידה דרבנן, לא גזרו שניות בהן:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:5:1.english: In [a case of] a forbidden relationship by Torah law - That is to say, regarding his wife, whose mother and mother's mother are a forbidden relationship by Torah law, the Sages decreed secondary [forbidden relationships]; but regarding a chalutzah, where even her [primary] forbidden relationships are rabbinic, they did not decree secondary [forbidden relationships] for them.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:5:2.hebrew: או דלמא לא שנא - וממתני' לא דייק דקתני היא אסורה באבי אביו משום כלת בנו דהוי שניה — הא קמייתינן לה לקמן עלה דהא מילתא, ומדחי ליה למימר לאו משום חולץ, אלא בשביל המת שהיתה זו אשתו גמורה, לפיכך אבי אביו אסור בה משום כלת בנו:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:5:2.english: Or perhaps there is no difference - And [as to why] it does not infer [this] from the Mishnah, which teaches that she is forbidden to his father's father because of his son's daughter-in-law, which is a secondary [forbidden relationship] — behold, we bring it below regarding this matter, and it rejects it, saying [that it is] not because of the one who performs chalitzah, rather because of the deceased [brother], for this woman was his full wife; therefore his father's father is forbidden to her because of his son's daughter-in-law.

Rashi on Yevamot 40b:7:1.hebrew: ה"א האחין מותרין - לא קאי אלא אאם אם אמה, דלא גזרו שניות בזיקה; אבל אמה ואם אמה, דהוו להו עריות דאורייתא לגבי אשה גמורה, לא משתרו אחין, דגזרו עריות בזיקה, ואפי' לאחר חליצה נימא דאיהו שליחותייהו עבד. משום הכי לא תנייה:
Rashi on Yevamot 40b:7:1.english: I would say [that] "the brothers are permitted" - [This] refers only to her mother's mother's mother, for [the Sages] did not decree secondary forbidden relatives [to apply] during the levirate bond; however, her mother and her mother's mother — which are biblical forbidden relatives with respect to a full wife — are not permitted to the brothers, for [the Sages] decreed forbidden relatives [to apply] during the levirate bond, and even after chalitzah we might say that he acted as their agent. For this reason, [the Tanna] did not teach it.

Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:14:1.hebrew: אמימר מוקי לה כו' - כל סוגיא דשמעתין דלא כאמימר, כדפרשתי לעיל (יבמות דף כא: ד"ה אמימר):
Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:14:1.english: "Ameimar establishes it, etc." - The entire sugya of our discussion is not in accordance with Ameimar, as I explained earlier (Yevamot 21b, s.v. Ameimar).

Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:24:1.hebrew: בבן בתו לאו משום חולץ - לא בעי לאוקמי בבן בתו דסבא, דומיא דבן בנו, דלא מיירי בבן בנו דסבא, דא"כ הויא ליה אשת אחי אביו דאורייתא:
Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:24:1.english: "To his daughter's son — is it not due to the one who performed ḥalitza" - [The Gemara] did not want to establish [this] as [referring to] the daughter's son of the grandfather, analogous to "his son's son," which does not refer to the son's son of the grandfather, for if so, she would be [forbidden to] him as his father's brother's wife by Torah law.

Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:26:1.hebrew: שמע מינה גזרו שניות בחלוצה - והא דלא תני במתניתין אבי אמו ובן בתו, משום דתנא ושייר. ומיהו רבי חייא דקתני מנינא, קשה דלא תנא בן אחותו ובן אחיו מן האם. ויש לומר דלא תנא אלא ארבע, כנגד ארבע של דברי תורה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:26:1.english: Conclude from it that [the Sages] decreed secondary [forbidden] relationships in [the case of] a ḥalutza - And [as for the fact] that [the Tanna] does not teach in our Mishnah his mother's father and his daughter's son, [that is] because he taught [some cases] and omitted [others]. However, [according to] Rabbi Ḥiyya, who teaches a specific count, it is difficult why he did not teach his sister's son and his maternal brother's son. And one can say that he only taught four, corresponding to the four of Torah law.

Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:7:1.hebrew: אבל אמה ואם אמה לא - והא דתנן בפרק ב' (לעיל יבמות כג:): "אחד חולץ ואחד מייבם", אלמא שרי באחותה — שאני התם, משום דאימור דידיה איתרמי ליה. והא נמי דתנן לקמן בפרקין (יבמות דף מא.): "החולץ ליבמתו ונשא אחיו את אחותה" — היינו דיעבד:
Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:7:1.english: But her mother and her mother's mother [are] not [permitted] - And [as for] that which we learned in a Mishnah in the second chapter (above, Yevamot 23b): "One performs chalitzah and one performs yibbum," from which we see that her sister is permitted [to the other brother] — there it is different, because [we say]: "Say that his [permitted] one chanced to come to him." And also that which we learned in a Mishnah later in our chapter (Yevamot 41a): "If one performs chalitzah to his yevamah and his brother marries her sister" — that is bedi'avad [after the fact].

Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:8:1.hebrew: וליתני אחין מותרין בכולן קשיא - הא דלא קאמר "אלא שמע מינה דלא גזרו שניות בחלוצה", היינו משום דלקמן מסיק דגזרו. ולא שייך לשנויי "תנא ושייר", כיון דלא תנא שום שניה אלא הני דאורייתא לחוד:
Tosafot on Yevamot 40b:8:1.english: And let it teach: "The brothers are permitted to all of them." Difficult - The reason [the Gemara] does not say, "Rather, conclude from this that they did not decree secondary forbidden relationships in the case of a chalutzah," is because later [the Gemara] concludes that they did decree [them]. And it is not applicable to answer "[the Tanna] taught [some] and omitted [others]," since [the Tanna] did not teach any secondary forbidden relationship at all, only these biblical ones alone.
